# Purpose

This file reads session CSVs (one event per row, `row_type` = trial / spin / shape / gaze), builds analysis tables at the correct observational level, and fits confirmatory models that treat **spinner type as a 6-level factor**.

Same-round liking is a separate dependent variable, not a covariate in the flow model. Round-level reward prediction error and surprise are **not** tested as if they were unexpected outcomes (they are nearly recodings of spinner type). Sample-to-sample gaze “switching” is not treated as attention switching.

A later section treats **eye-tracking summaries as DVs** and asks how they correlate with, and are predicted by, same-round flow, liking, and happiness (hierarchical models with a participant intercept).

**Nothing is written to disk.** Exploratory material that cannot support inference is in the appendix.

# 1. Packages

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
required_packages <- c(
  "tidyverse",
  "lme4",
  "lmerTest",
  "ordinal",
  "emmeans",
  "broom",
  "broom.mixed",
  "jsonlite"
)

missing_packages <- setdiff(required_packages, rownames(installed.packages()))
if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing packages: ", paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "),
    ". Install them, then re-knit. This file does not call install.packages()."
  )
}

library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(ordinal)
library(emmeans)
library(broom)
library(broom.mixed)

# Later packages can mask dplyr generics (slice/select/filter).
select <- dplyr::select
filter <- dplyr::filter
mutate <- dplyr::mutate
summarise <- dplyr::summarise
summarize <- dplyr::summarise
slice <- dplyr::slice
rename <- dplyr::rename

WHEEL_LEVELS <- c("all1", "low", "medium", "high", "half51", "all5")
E3_LEVELS <- c("low", "medium", "high", "half51")

FALLBACK_ORDERS <- list(
  high   = c(5, 2, 1, 4, 2, 2, 5, 1, 4, 4, 1, 5),
  medium = c(4, 4, 2, 2, 2, 4, 4, 2, 4, 4, 2, 2),
  half51 = c(1, 5, 5, 1, 5, 5, 5, 1, 1, 1, 1, 5)
)

parse_outcome_order <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || is.na(x) || !nzchar(x)) return(numeric(0))
  vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(strsplit(as.character(x), "-", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]))
  vals[is.finite(vals)]
}

programmed_rewards <- function(spinner_type, high_ord, medium_ord, half51_ord) {
  if (is.na(spinner_type)) return(numeric(0))
  switch(
    spinner_type,
    low    = rep(3, 12),
    all1   = rep(1, 12),
    all5   = rep(5, 12),
    high   = {
      x <- parse_outcome_order(high_ord)
      if (length(x)) x else FALLBACK_ORDERS$high
    },
    medium = {
      x <- parse_outcome_order(medium_ord)
      if (length(x)) x else FALLBACK_ORDERS$medium
    },
    half51 = {
      x <- parse_outcome_order(half51_ord)
      if (length(x)) x else FALLBACK_ORDERS$half51
    },
    numeric(0)
  )
}

reward_entropy <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  p <- as.numeric(table(x) / length(x))
  -sum(p * log(p))
}

is_main_task_row <- function(spinner_type, phase, bonus_round, round) {
  !is.na(spinner_type) &
    spinner_type %in% WHEEL_LEVELS &
    !is.na(round) &
    is.na(bonus_round) &
    (is.na(phase) | !phase %in% c("spin_practice", "bonus"))
}

# Gaussian mixed model; ordinary lm if only one participant (random intercept unidentified).
fit_gaussian <- function(formula, data, cluster = "participant_id") {
  n_id <- dplyr::n_distinct(data[[cluster]])
  if (n_id >= 2) {
    fit <- try(lmerTest::lmer(formula, data = data, REML = TRUE), silent = TRUE)
    if (!inherits(fit, "try-error")) return(fit)
    message("lmer failed (", conditionMessage(attr(fit, "condition")), "); using lm.")
  } else {
    message("Only ", n_id, " participant(s): fitting lm without a random intercept.")
  }
  lm(lme4::nobars(formula), data = data)
}

fit_ordinal <- function(formula, data, cluster = "participant_id") {
  n_id <- dplyr::n_distinct(data[[cluster]])
  n_lev <- nlevels(data$flow_ord)
  if (n_id < 2) {
    message("Ordinal mixed model skipped: need at least 2 participants (have ", n_id, ").")
    return(NULL)
  }
  if (n_lev < 3) {
    message("Ordinal mixed model skipped: ordered flow has ", n_lev, " level(s).")
    return(NULL)
  }
  fit <- try(ordinal::clmm(formula, data = data, Hess = TRUE), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
    message("clmm failed: ", conditionMessage(attr(fit, "condition")))
    return(NULL)
  }
  fit
}

summarize_fit <- function(model) {
  if (is.null(model)) return(invisible(NULL))
  print(summary(model))
  invisible(model)
}

spinner_contrasts <- function(model) {
  if (is.null(model)) return(invisible(NULL))
  emm <- try(emmeans::emmeans(model, ~ spinner_type), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(emm, "try-error")) {
    message("emmeans skipped: ", conditionMessage(attr(emm, "condition")))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  cat("\nEstimated marginal means\n")
  print(emm)
  levs <- as.character(emm@levels$spinner_type)
  coef_in_order <- function(...) {
    v <- c(...)
    out <- setNames(rep(0, length(levs)), levs)
    common <- intersect(names(v), names(out))
    out[common] <- v[common]
    unname(out)
  }
  mag <- emmeans::contrast(emm, method = list(
    all5_vs_all1 = coef_in_order(all5 = 1, all1 = -1),
    e3_vs_extremes = coef_in_order(
      low = 0.25, medium = 0.25, high = 0.25, half51 = 0.25,
      all1 = -0.5, all5 = -0.5
    )
  ))
  cat("\nMagnitude contrasts\n")
  print(mag)
  e3_levs <- intersect(E3_LEVELS, levs)
  if (length(e3_levs) >= 2) {
    emm_e3 <- emmeans::emmeans(model, ~ spinner_type, at = list(spinner_type = e3_levs))
    cat("\nUncertainty pairwise (E[reward] = 3 wheels)\n")
    print(pairs(emm_e3, adjust = "holm"))
  }
  invisible(list(emm = emm, magnitude = mag))
}

theme_set(theme_classic())
```

# 2. Import

Looks in `Analysis/` first, then `../sample_data`. New DataPipe files have `row_type`. The older wide sample (`webgazer_data` JSON on trial rows) is expanded into gaze rows.

```{r import}
candidate_dirs <- c(".", "../sample_data")
data_dir <- NA_character_
csv_files <- character(0)
for (dir in candidate_dirs) {
  found <- list.files(dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
  if (length(found) > 0) {
    data_dir <- dir
    csv_files <- found
    break
  }
}

if (length(csv_files) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No .csv files in Analysis/ or ../sample_data. ",
    "Put session CSVs next to this Rmd and knit again."
  )
}

# Older jsPsych export: one trial per row, gaze packed in webgazer_data JSON.
expand_legacy_csv <- function(d) {
  if ("row_type" %in% names(d)) return(d)
  d$row_type <- "trial"
  if (!"webgazer_data" %in% names(d)) return(d)
  carry <- intersect(
    c(
      "subject", "run_mode", "session_code", "source_file", "trial_index",
      "phase", "spinner_type", "round", "bonus_round", "order"
    ),
    names(d)
  )
  gaze <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(d)), function(i) {
    js <- d$webgazer_data[[i]]
    if (is.na(js) || !nzchar(js) || js %in% c("[]", "{}", "\"\"")) return(tibble())
    pts <- try(jsonlite::fromJSON(js), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(pts, "try-error") || is.null(pts)) return(tibble())
    pts <- tibble::as_tibble(pts)
    if (nrow(pts) == 0 || !all(c("x", "y") %in% names(pts))) return(tibble())
    out <- tibble(row_type = "gaze", gaze_x = pts$x, gaze_y = pts$y)
    out$t <- if ("t" %in% names(pts)) pts$t else NA_real_
    for (nm in carry) out[[nm]] <- d[[nm]][[i]]
    out
  })
  dplyr::bind_rows(d, gaze)
}

cat("Folder:", normalizePath(data_dir, mustWork = FALSE), "\n")
cat("CSV files:\n")
print(basename(csv_files))

data_list <- purrr::map(csv_files, function(path) {
  d <- readr::read_csv(
    path,
    col_types = readr::cols(.default = readr::col_character()),
    na = c("", "NA", "NaN", "NULL"),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
  d$source_file <- basename(path)
  expand_legacy_csv(d)
})

data <- dplyr::bind_rows(data_list)
rm(data_list)

cat("Rows:", nrow(data), "  columns:", ncol(data), "\n")
if ("row_type" %in% names(data)) print(count(data, row_type))
```

# 3. Clean types

`subject`, `session_code`, `run_mode`, `phase`, `near_edge`, and spinner labels stay character.

```{r cleaning}
for (nm in c("session_code", "phase", "bonus_round", "round", "spinner_type",
             "high_outcome_order", "medium_outcome_order", "half51_outcome_order",
             "t_start", "t_land", "spin_index", "outcome", "hold_ms")) {
  if (!nm %in% names(data)) data[[nm]] <- NA_character_
}

char_keep <- intersect(
  c(
    "row_type", "subject", "run_mode", "session_code", "source_file",
    "phase", "trial_type", "internal_node_id", "user_agent",
    "spinner_type", "order_perm", "chosen_spinner",
    "high_outcome_order", "medium_outcome_order", "half51_outcome_order",
    "distractor_seed", "distractor_schedule",
    "response", "liking_label", "happiness_label", "view_history",
    "near_edge", "neighbor_outcome", "shape", "shape_trigger",
    # validation trials store JSON arrays
    "average_offset", "validation_points", "percent_in_roi", "val_point_median_px",
    "eye_tracking"
  ),
  names(data)
)

numeric_variables <- setdiff(names(data), char_keep)

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    across(where(is.character), ~ na_if(str_squish(.x), "")),
    across(all_of(numeric_variables), ~ suppressWarnings(readr::parse_number(.x)))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    participant_id = as.character(subject),
    # session_code is only on trial rows; one CSV = one session
    session_id = paste(participant_id, source_file, sep = "|"),
    spinner_type = factor(spinner_type, levels = WHEEL_LEVELS),
    main_task = is_main_task_row(as.character(spinner_type), phase, bonus_round, round)
  )

session_quality <- data %>%
  group_by(session_id, participant_id) %>%
  summarise(
    # run_mode is only on trial rows
    run_mode = dplyr::first(na.omit(run_mode)),
    n_gaze = sum(row_type == "gaze", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_spin = sum(row_type == "spin", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_trial = sum(row_type == "trial", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    is_test = !is.na(run_mode) & run_mode == "test",
    has_gaze = n_gaze > 0
  )

cat("Sessions:\n")
print(session_quality)
```

# 4. Programmed reward properties

Parsed from `high_outcome_order` / `medium_outcome_order` / `half51_outcome_order` on each session (seed-42 fallback if those cells are empty). These describe the **design**, not experienced luck.

```{r reward-properties}
session_design <- data %>%
  group_by(session_id) %>%
  summarise(
    high_outcome_order = { x <- high_outcome_order[!is.na(high_outcome_order)]; if (length(x)) x[1] else NA_character_ },
    medium_outcome_order = { x <- medium_outcome_order[!is.na(medium_outcome_order)]; if (length(x)) x[1] else NA_character_ },
    half51_outcome_order = { x <- half51_outcome_order[!is.na(half51_outcome_order)]; if (length(x)) x[1] else NA_character_ },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

wheel_design <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  session_id = session_design$session_id,
  spinner_type = WHEEL_LEVELS
) %>%
  left_join(session_design, by = "session_id") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    programmed = list(programmed_rewards(
      spinner_type, high_outcome_order, medium_outcome_order, half51_outcome_order
    )),
    expected_reward = if (length(programmed)) mean(programmed) else NA_real_,
    reward_variance = if (length(programmed) > 1) var(programmed) else if (length(programmed) == 1) 0 else NA_real_,
    reward_entropy = reward_entropy(programmed)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-programmed, -high_outcome_order, -medium_outcome_order, -half51_outcome_order) %>%
  mutate(spinner_type = factor(spinner_type, levels = WHEEL_LEVELS))

wheel_design %>%
  distinct(spinner_type, expected_reward, reward_variance, reward_entropy) %>%
  arrange(expected_reward, reward_variance)
```

Note: `all1`, `low`, and `all5` all have variance 0 but different means (1, 3, 5). `medium` and `half51` have the same entropy and different variance. Confirmatory models use `spinner_type`, not variance.

# 5. Analysis tables

One row per session × round for ratings. Gaze is **not** copied onto those rows until a later join of summaries.

Confirmatory sample: main 6 wheels, not test mode, not practice, not bonus.

```{r analysis-tables}
flow_items <- data %>%
  filter(row_type == "trial", main_task, !is.na(flow)) %>%
  select(session_id, participant_id, run_mode, round, spinner_type, flow, score, response)

liking_items <- data %>%
  filter(row_type == "trial", main_task, !is.na(liking)) %>%
  select(session_id, round, liking)

happiness_items <- data %>%
  filter(row_type == "trial", main_task, !is.na(happiness)) %>%
  select(session_id, round, happiness)

spin_trials <- data %>%
  filter(row_type == "trial", main_task, !is.na(n_spins)) %>%
  group_by(session_id, round) %>%
  dplyr::slice_min(trial_index, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(session_id, round, n_spins, score, spinner_type)

rounds <- flow_items %>%
  group_by(session_id, round) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(liking_items %>% group_by(session_id, round) %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = 1) %>% ungroup(),
            by = c("session_id", "round")) %>%
  left_join(happiness_items %>% group_by(session_id, round) %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = 1) %>% ungroup(),
            by = c("session_id", "round")) %>%
  left_join(spin_trials %>% select(session_id, round, n_spins),
            by = c("session_id", "round"),
            suffix = c("", "_spin")) %>%
  left_join(session_quality %>% select(session_id, is_test, has_gaze, n_gaze),
            by = "session_id") %>%
  left_join(wheel_design, by = c("session_id", "spinner_type")) %>%
  mutate(
    spinner_type = factor(spinner_type, levels = WHEEL_LEVELS),
    stopped_early = !is.na(n_spins) & n_spins < 12,
    confirmatory = !is_test
  )

rounds_c <- rounds %>% filter(confirmatory)

spins <- data %>%
  filter(row_type == "spin", main_task) %>%
  left_join(session_quality %>% select(session_id, is_test, has_gaze), by = "session_id") %>%
  left_join(wheel_design, by = c("session_id", "spinner_type")) %>%
  mutate(
    spinner_type = factor(spinner_type, levels = WHEEL_LEVELS),
    spin_duration_ms = t_land - t_start,
    rpe_design = outcome - expected_reward,
    abs_rpe_design = abs(rpe_design)
  )

# Outcome probability from the session's programmed list
order_lookup <- session_design %>%
  mutate(
    seq_high = map(high_outcome_order, parse_outcome_order),
    seq_medium = map(medium_outcome_order, parse_outcome_order),
    seq_half51 = map(half51_outcome_order, parse_outcome_order)
  )

spins <- spins %>%
  left_join(order_lookup %>% select(session_id, seq_high, seq_medium, seq_half51),
            by = "session_id") %>%
  mutate(
    programmed = purrr::pmap(
      list(as.character(spinner_type), seq_high, seq_medium, seq_half51),
      function(st, h, m, f) programmed_rewards(
        st,
        paste(h, collapse = "-"),
        paste(m, collapse = "-"),
        paste(f, collapse = "-")
      )
    ),
    observed_outcome_probability = purrr::map2_dbl(programmed, outcome, function(seqn, out) {
      if (length(seqn) == 0 || is.na(out)) return(NA_real_)
      mean(seqn == out)
    }),
    outcome_surprise = if_else(
      !is.na(observed_outcome_probability) & observed_outcome_probability > 0,
      -log(observed_outcome_probability),
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-programmed, -seq_high, -seq_medium, -seq_half51)

spins_c <- spins %>% filter(!is_test)

# Gaze rows sometimes omit spinner_type / round; copy from the parent trial.
if (all(c("session_id", "trial_index") %in% names(data))) {
  trial_design <- data %>%
    filter(row_type == "trial") %>%
    select(any_of(c(
      "session_id", "trial_index", "spinner_type", "round", "phase", "bonus_round"
    ))) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    rename_with(~ paste0(., "_tr"), -any_of(c("session_id", "trial_index")))
  if (nrow(trial_design) > 0) {
    data <- data %>%
      left_join(trial_design, by = intersect(c("session_id", "trial_index"), names(trial_design)))
    if ("spinner_type_tr" %in% names(data)) {
      data$spinner_type <- factor(
        coalesce(as.character(data$spinner_type), as.character(data$spinner_type_tr)),
        levels = WHEEL_LEVELS
      )
    }
    if ("round_tr" %in% names(data)) {
      data$round <- coalesce(data$round, suppressWarnings(as.numeric(data$round_tr)))
    }
    if ("phase_tr" %in% names(data)) {
      data$phase <- coalesce(data$phase, data$phase_tr)
    }
    if ("bonus_round_tr" %in% names(data)) {
      data$bonus_round <- coalesce(
        data$bonus_round,
        suppressWarnings(as.numeric(data$bonus_round_tr))
      )
    }
    data$main_task <- is_main_task_row(
      as.character(data$spinner_type), data$phase, data$bonus_round, data$round
    )
    data <- data %>% select(-ends_with("_tr"))
  }
}

gaze_raw <- data %>% filter(row_type == "gaze")
for (nm in c(
  "wheel_x", "wheel_y", "wheel_r", "needle_x", "needle_y", "needle_w", "needle_h",
  "spinning", "shape_visible"
)) {
  if (!nm %in% names(gaze_raw)) gaze_raw[[nm]] <- NA_real_
}
gaze_xy <- gaze_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(gaze_x), !is.na(gaze_y)) %>%
  left_join(session_quality %>% select(session_id, is_test, has_gaze), by = "session_id") %>%
  mutate(
    spinner_type = factor(spinner_type, levels = WHEEL_LEVELS),
    has_wheel = !is.na(wheel_x) & !is.na(wheel_y) & !is.na(wheel_r) & wheel_r > 0,
    wx = if_else(has_wheel, (gaze_x - wheel_x) / wheel_r, NA_real_),
    wy = if_else(has_wheel, (gaze_y - wheel_y) / wheel_r, NA_real_),
    nx = if_else(has_wheel, (needle_x - wheel_x) / wheel_r, NA_real_),
    ny = if_else(has_wheel, (needle_y - wheel_y) / wheel_r, NA_real_),
    nw = if_else(has_wheel, needle_w / wheel_r, NA_real_),
    nh = if_else(has_wheel, needle_h / wheel_r, NA_real_),
    ecc = sqrt(wx^2 + wy^2)
  )

cat("Gaze inclusion\n")
cat("  row_type == gaze:", nrow(gaze_raw), "\n")
cat("  with x,y:", nrow(gaze_xy), "\n")
cat("  main_task:", sum(gaze_xy$main_task %in% TRUE), "\n")
cat("  wheel layout:", sum(gaze_xy$has_wheel %in% TRUE), "\n")
cat("  ecc < 3:", sum(is.finite(gaze_xy$ecc) & gaze_xy$ecc < 3), "\n")
if ("spinning" %in% names(gaze_xy)) {
  cat("  spinning == 1:", sum(gaze_xy$spinning == 1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
}
cat("  test sessions:", sum(gaze_xy$is_test %in% TRUE), "\n")

gaze_ok <- gaze_xy %>%
  filter(main_task %in% TRUE, has_wheel %in% TRUE, is.finite(ecc), ecc < 3)

if (nrow(gaze_ok) == 0) {
  gaze_ok <- gaze_xy %>% filter(main_task %in% TRUE, has_wheel %in% TRUE, is.finite(wx))
  if (nrow(gaze_ok) > 0) message("ecc < 3 dropped every sample; using all wheel-centered gaze.")
}
if (nrow(gaze_ok) == 0) {
  gaze_ok <- gaze_xy %>% filter(has_wheel %in% TRUE, is.finite(wx))
  if (nrow(gaze_ok) > 0) message("No main-task wheel gaze; using any wheel-centered gaze.")
}
if (nrow(gaze_ok) == 0 && nrow(gaze_xy) > 0) {
  gaze_ok <- gaze_xy %>%
    group_by(session_id, trial_index) %>%
    mutate(
      wx = (gaze_x - median(gaze_x, na.rm = TRUE)) / pmax(IQR(gaze_x, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      wy = (gaze_y - median(gaze_y, na.rm = TRUE)) / pmax(IQR(gaze_y, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      ecc = sqrt(wx^2 + wy^2)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  message("No wheel layout on gaze rows; maps are trial-centered (not wheel radii).")
}

gaze_spin <- gaze_ok %>% filter(spinning == 1)
gaze_shape <- gaze_ok %>% filter(shape_visible == 1)
gaze_idle <- gaze_ok %>% filter(is.na(spinning) | spinning != 1)

n_participants <- n_distinct(rounds_c$participant_id)
n_rounds <- nrow(rounds_c)

cat(
  "Confirmatory rounds:", n_rounds,
  "  participants:", n_participants, "\n",
  "Spins:", nrow(spins_c),
  "  gaze while spinning:", nrow(gaze_spin),
  "  gaze while shape visible:", nrow(gaze_shape), "\n"
)

count(rounds_c, spinner_type)
```

# 6. Descriptives

```{r descriptives}
rounds_c %>%
  group_by(spinner_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_flow = mean(flow, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_flow = sd(flow, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_liking = mean(liking, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_happiness = mean(happiness, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_n_spins = mean(n_spins, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_stopped_early = mean(stopped_early, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

spins_c %>%
  group_by(spinner_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n_spins = n(),
    mean_outcome = mean(outcome, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_outcome = sd(outcome, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_hold_ms = mean(hold_ms, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r plot-ratings-by-condition, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
plot_by_wheel <- function(df, y, ylab, title) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = spinner_type, y = .data[[y]], group = participant_id)) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.25) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    stat_summary(aes(group = 1), fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3) +
    labs(x = "Spinner type", y = ylab, title = title)
}

plot_by_wheel(rounds_c, "flow", "Flow (0–10)", "Flow by spinner type")
plot_by_wheel(rounds_c, "liking", "Liking (1–5)", "Liking by spinner type")
plot_by_wheel(rounds_c, "happiness", "Happiness (1–5)", "Happiness by spinner type")
```

```{r plot-flow-order}
ggplot(rounds_c, aes(x = round, y = flow, group = participant_id)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  stat_summary(aes(group = 1), fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 1.1) +
  labs(x = "Presentation order (round)", y = "Flow", title = "Flow across the session")
```

# 7. Confirmatory models

Primary DV: flow. Predictor: `spinner_type` (6-level factor) plus presentation `round`. Random intercept for participant when two or more people are present.

Liking is **not** in this model.

```{r confirmatory-flow}
flow_data <- rounds_c %>%
  filter(!is.na(flow), !is.na(spinner_type), !is.na(round)) %>%
  mutate(flow_ord = ordered(flow))

flow_lmm <- fit_gaussian(flow ~ spinner_type + round + (1 | participant_id), flow_data)
summarize_fit(flow_lmm)
spinner_contrasts(flow_lmm)

flow_clmm <- fit_ordinal(
  flow_ord ~ spinner_type + round + (1 | participant_id),
  flow_data
)
summarize_fit(flow_clmm)
```

## Liking (separate DV)

```{r confirmatory-liking}
liking_data <- rounds_c %>% filter(!is.na(liking), !is.na(spinner_type), !is.na(round))
liking_lmm <- fit_gaussian(liking ~ spinner_type + round + (1 | participant_id), liking_data)
summarize_fit(liking_lmm)
spinner_contrasts(liking_lmm)
```

## Happiness (separate DV)

```{r confirmatory-happiness}
happiness_data <- rounds_c %>% filter(!is.na(happiness), !is.na(spinner_type), !is.na(round))
happiness_lmm <- fit_gaussian(happiness ~ spinner_type + round + (1 | participant_id), happiness_data)
summarize_fit(happiness_lmm)
spinner_contrasts(happiness_lmm)
```

# 8. Persistence (secondary)

`n_spins` is bounded 4–12 on main wheels. Linear mixed model on that scale, plus a binomial model of stopping before 12.

```{r persistence}
spin_n_data <- rounds_c %>% filter(!is.na(n_spins), !is.na(spinner_type))

nspins_lmm <- fit_gaussian(n_spins ~ spinner_type + round + (1 | participant_id), spin_n_data)
summarize_fit(nspins_lmm)
spinner_contrasts(nspins_lmm)

early_data <- spin_n_data %>% mutate(stopped_early = as.integer(stopped_early))
if (n_distinct(early_data$participant_id) >= 2 && n_distinct(early_data$stopped_early) == 2) {
  early_fit <- try(
    glmer(
      stopped_early ~ spinner_type + round + (1 | participant_id),
      data = early_data,
      family = binomial
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  if (!inherits(early_fit, "try-error")) print(summary(early_fit)) else {
    early_fit <- glm(stopped_early ~ spinner_type + round, data = early_data, family = binomial)
    print(summary(early_fit))
  }
} else if (n_distinct(early_data$stopped_early) == 2) {
  early_fit <- glm(stopped_early ~ spinner_type + round, data = early_data, family = binomial)
  message("Binomial glm (no random intercept).")
  print(summary(early_fit))
} else {
  cat("stopped_early has no variation; binomial model skipped.\n")
}

ggplot(spin_n_data, aes(x = spinner_type, y = n_spins, group = participant_id)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  stat_summary(aes(group = 1), fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3) +
  labs(x = "Spinner type", y = "Spins (4–12)", title = "Persistence by spinner type")
```

# Eye-tracking QC (data quality)

Accuracy comes from the 5-point checks right after calibration (`pre`) and after the bonus spin (`post`). The gaze model is frozen after calibration (no click or mouse retraining), so post minus pre is drift. Offsets are viewport px, the same space as `gaze_x` / `gaze_y`. Timing (display frame rate, long frames over 50 ms, WebGazer and Face Landmarker sample rates) is logged per gaze-tracked trial and summarized over main-task wheels.

Provisional flags, reported only (nobody is excluded yet): pre-check median offset > 200 px, or median WebGazer rate < 15 Hz. Older sessions without these fields show `NA`.

```{r eyetracking-qc}
qc_data <- data
for (nm in c("val_median_offset_px", "val_mean_offset_px", "val_pct_in_roi", "samples_per_sec",
             "wg_hz", "iris_hz", "raf_fps", "long_frames", "wg_max_gap_ms", "iris_face_ok", "cam_fps")) {
  if (!nm %in% names(qc_data)) qc_data[[nm]] <- NA_real_
}

val_rows <- qc_data %>%
  filter(row_type == "trial", phase %in% c("eyetracking_validation_pre", "eyetracking_validation_post")) %>%
  transmute(
    session_id, participant_id,
    check = sub("eyetracking_validation_", "", phase),
    median_px = val_median_offset_px,
    mean_px = val_mean_offset_px,
    pct_in_roi = val_pct_in_roi,
    val_hz = samples_per_sec
  )

val_wide <- if (nrow(val_rows)) {
  val_rows %>%
    group_by(session_id, participant_id, check) %>%
    dplyr::slice_tail(n = 1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = check, values_from = c(median_px, mean_px, pct_in_roi, val_hz),
                names_glue = "{.value}_{check}")
} else {
  tibble(session_id = character(), participant_id = character())
}
for (nm in c("median_px_pre", "median_px_post", "mean_px_pre", "mean_px_post",
             "pct_in_roi_pre", "pct_in_roi_post")) {
  if (!nm %in% names(val_wide)) val_wide[[nm]] <- NA_real_
}

timing_qc <- qc_data %>%
  filter(row_type == "trial", main_task) %>%
  group_by(session_id, participant_id) %>%
  summarise(
    wg_hz_med = median(wg_hz, na.rm = TRUE),
    iris_hz_med = median(iris_hz, na.rm = TRUE),
    raf_fps_med = median(raf_fps, na.rm = TRUE),
    long_frames_per_wheel = mean(long_frames, na.rm = TRUE),
    wg_max_gap_ms_med = median(wg_max_gap_ms, na.rm = TRUE),
    iris_face_ok_mean = mean(iris_face_ok, na.rm = TRUE),
    cam_fps = suppressWarnings(max(cam_fps, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ if_else(is.finite(.x), .x, NA_real_)))

eyetracking_qc <- qc_data %>%
  group_by(session_id, participant_id) %>%
  summarise(
    is_test = any(!is.na(run_mode) & run_mode == "test"),
    has_gaze = any(row_type == "gaze", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(val_wide, by = c("session_id", "participant_id")) %>%
  left_join(timing_qc, by = c("session_id", "participant_id")) %>%
  mutate(
    drift_px = median_px_post - median_px_pre,
    flag_accuracy = !is.na(median_px_pre) & median_px_pre > 200,
    flag_rate = !is.na(wg_hz_med) & wg_hz_med < 15,
    qc_flag = flag_accuracy | flag_rate
  )

eyetracking_qc %>%
  select(participant_id, is_test, median_px_pre, median_px_post, drift_px,
         pct_in_roi_pre, pct_in_roi_post, wg_hz_med, iris_hz_med, raf_fps_med,
         long_frames_per_wheel, wg_max_gap_ms_med, cam_fps, qc_flag) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 1))) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

# 9. Gaze during spins (secondary)

AOI proportions are computed only while `spinning == 1`. Needle vs wheel are compositional (`prop_needle + prop_other = 1` if other includes wheel). Models use **prop_needle** only.

Sessions with no gaze (eye-tracking bypass) are flagged, not silently dropped from the rating models above.

```{r gaze-spin-summary}
gaze_round <- gaze_spin %>%
  filter(!is_test) %>%
  group_by(session_id, participant_id, round, spinner_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = n(),
    prop_needle = mean(on_needle == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_dist_needle = mean(dist_needle, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(rounds_c %>% select(session_id, round, flow, liking, has_gaze),
            by = c("session_id", "round"))

gaze_round %>%
  group_by(spinner_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_prop_needle = mean(prop_needle, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_dist_needle = mean(mean_dist_needle, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

if (nrow(gaze_round) > 0) {
  needle_cond <- fit_gaussian(
    prop_needle ~ spinner_type + (1 | participant_id),
    gaze_round
  )
  summarize_fit(needle_cond)
  spinner_contrasts(needle_cond)

  needle_flow <- gaze_round %>% filter(!is.na(flow))
  if (nrow(needle_flow) > 0) {
    needle_flow_m <- fit_gaussian(
      prop_needle ~ flow + spinner_type + (1 | participant_id),
      needle_flow
    )
    summarize_fit(needle_flow_m)
  }
} else {
  cat("No spinning gaze samples in the confirmatory sessions.\n")
}
```

```{r plot-needle}
if (nrow(gaze_round) > 0) {
  ggplot(gaze_round, aes(x = spinner_type, y = prop_needle, group = participant_id)) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.25) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    stat_summary(aes(group = 1), fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3) +
    labs(
      x = "Spinner type",
      y = "Proportion of spinning samples on needle",
      title = "Needle AOI during spins"
    )
}
```

## Distance to needle as the wheel slows (descriptive)

```{r time-to-land}
gaze_ttl <- gaze_spin %>% filter(FALSE)
if (nrow(gaze_spin) > 0 &&
    all(c("t_land", "spin_index") %in% names(spins_c)) &&
    all(c("spin_index", "t") %in% names(gaze_spin))) {
  land_times <- spins_c %>%
    select(session_id, round, spin_index, spin_t_land = t_land)
  gaze_ttl <- gaze_spin %>%
    filter(is.na(is_test) | !is_test) %>%
    left_join(land_times, by = c("session_id", "round", "spin_index")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(spin_t_land), !is.na(t), t <= spin_t_land) %>%
    mutate(
      ms_to_land = spin_t_land - t,
      bin = cut(
        ms_to_land,
        breaks = c(-Inf, 250, 500, 1000, 2000, 4000, Inf),
        labels = c("0–250", "250–500", "500–1000", "1–2 s", "2–4 s", ">4 s")
      )
    )
} else {
  cat("Time-to-land skipped: no t_land / spin_index on this file.\n")
}

if (nrow(gaze_ttl) > 0) {
  ttl_summary <- gaze_ttl %>%
    group_by(spinner_type, bin) %>%
    summarise(mean_dist_needle = mean(dist_needle, na.rm = TRUE), n = n(), .groups = "drop")

  print(ttl_summary)

  ggplot(ttl_summary, aes(x = bin, y = mean_dist_needle, group = spinner_type, color = spinner_type)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point() +
    labs(
      x = "Time to land",
      y = "Mean distance to needle (px)",
      color = "Spinner",
      title = "Needle distance over the coast (descriptive)"
    ) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
}
```

# 10. Distractor capture (secondary)

Only while `shape_visible == 1`. Baseline is the same spin, same shape coordinates, when the shape is off. Jitter and `cut_short` are not DVs.

```{r distractor-capture}
shape_radius <- function(size) size / 2

gaze_shape_cmp <- gaze_ok %>%
  filter(!is_test, !is.na(dist_shape), !is.na(spin_index), !is.na(shape_visible)) %>%
  mutate(on_shape = dist_shape <= shape_radius(shape_size)) %>%
  group_by(session_id, participant_id, round, spinner_type, spin_index, shape_visible) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_dist_shape = mean(dist_shape, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_on_shape = mean(on_shape, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(visible = factor(if_else(shape_visible == 1, "visible", "off"),
                          levels = c("off", "visible")))

pair_cols <- c(
  "mean_dist_shape_visible", "mean_dist_shape_off",
  "prop_on_shape_visible", "prop_on_shape_off"
)

capture_wide <- if (nrow(gaze_shape_cmp) == 0) {
  tibble()
} else {
  gaze_shape_cmp %>%
    select(session_id, participant_id, round, spinner_type, spin_index,
           visible, mean_dist_shape, prop_on_shape) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = visible,
      values_from = c(mean_dist_shape, prop_on_shape),
      names_expand = TRUE
    )
}

missing_pair <- setdiff(pair_cols, names(capture_wide))
if (length(missing_pair) > 0) {
  capture_wide[missing_pair] <- NA_real_
}

capture_wide <- capture_wide %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_dist_shape_visible), !is.na(mean_dist_shape_off)) %>%
  mutate(
    dist_capture = mean_dist_shape_off - mean_dist_shape_visible,
    prop_capture = prop_on_shape_visible - prop_on_shape_off
  )

if (nrow(capture_wide) > 0) {
  capture_round <- capture_wide %>%
    group_by(session_id, participant_id, round, spinner_type) %>%
    summarise(
      dist_capture = mean(dist_capture, na.rm = TRUE),
      prop_capture = mean(prop_capture, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_dist_visible = mean(mean_dist_shape_visible, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    left_join(rounds_c %>% select(session_id, round, flow), by = c("session_id", "round"))

  print(capture_round %>%
          group_by(spinner_type) %>%
          summarise(across(c(dist_capture, prop_capture, mean_dist_visible),
                           ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop"))

  cap_m <- fit_gaussian(
    dist_capture ~ spinner_type + (1 | participant_id),
    capture_round
  )
  summarize_fit(cap_m)
} else {
  cat("No paired visible/off shape-gaze samples.\n")
}
```

# 11. Gaze measures with flow, liking, and happiness

One row per confirmatory wheel. Gaze is summarized first, then joined to that wheel’s ratings. Webcam error is often 100–200 px, so these are toward vs. away, not fixations.

**Measures**

- Needle and wheel AOI, and mean needle distance, while the wheel is spinning
- Mean eccentricity (distance from wheel center, in wheel radii)
- Sample-to-sample jump while spinning (stability, and also tracker noise)
- Needle approach: mean distance early in the coast (`ms_to_land` ≥ 2 s) minus late (`≤ 500` ms). Positive = closer to the needle as the wheel slows
- Mean distance to a visible distractor
- Needle AOI while spinning minus while idle

**Models.** Each gaze measure is the DV. Predictors are within-person centered flow, liking, and happiness (that wheel minus the child’s own mean), plus `spinner_type` and `round`, and a participant intercept. That asks whether a child who reports more flow or liking *than they usually do* looks differently on that wheel, holding wheel type fixed. With only one participant the between-person terms are dropped and the random intercept is omitted (`lm`). These associations are secondary; they do not license “flow causes focused attention.”

```{r gaze-rating-features}
if (!"on_wheel" %in% names(gaze_ok)) gaze_ok$on_wheel <- NA_real_
if (!"dist_shape" %in% names(gaze_ok)) gaze_ok$dist_shape <- NA_real_
if (!"shape_visible" %in% names(gaze_ok)) gaze_ok$shape_visible <- NA_real_
if (!"shape_size" %in% names(gaze_ok)) gaze_ok$shape_size <- NA_real_

finite_mean <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) NA_real_ else mean(x)
}

gaze_aoi <- gaze_ok %>%
  filter(!is_test) %>%
  group_by(session_id, participant_id, round, spinner_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n_gaze = n(),
    n_spin_gaze = sum(spinning == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_needle_spin = finite_mean(on_needle[spinning == 1] == 1),
    prop_wheel_spin = finite_mean(on_wheel[spinning == 1] == 1),
    mean_dist_needle_spin = finite_mean(dist_needle[spinning == 1]),
    mean_ecc_spin = finite_mean(ecc[spinning == 1]),
    prop_needle_idle = finite_mean(on_needle[is.na(spinning) | spinning != 1] == 1),
    mean_dist_shape_vis = finite_mean(dist_shape[shape_visible == 1]),
    prop_near_shape = finite_mean(
      dist_shape[shape_visible == 1] <= (coalesce(shape_size[shape_visible == 1], 30) / 2)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(prop_needle_spin_minus_idle = prop_needle_spin - prop_needle_idle)

gaze_jump <- gaze_ok %>%
  filter(!is_test, spinning == 1) %>%
  arrange(session_id, round, t) %>%
  group_by(session_id, participant_id, round, spinner_type) %>%
  mutate(
    dt = t - lag(t),
    jump = sqrt((gaze_x - lag(gaze_x))^2 + (gaze_y - lag(gaze_y))^2)
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(jump), is.finite(dt), dt > 0, dt < 200) %>%
  summarise(mean_jump_px = finite_mean(jump), .groups = "drop")

gaze_coast_sum <- tibble(
  session_id = character(),
  participant_id = character(),
  round = numeric(),
  spinner_type = factor(levels = WHEEL_LEVELS),
  dist_needle_late = numeric(),
  dist_needle_early = numeric(),
  needle_approach = numeric()
)
if (nrow(gaze_ok) > 0 &&
    all(c("t_land", "spin_index") %in% names(spins_c)) &&
    all(c("spin_index", "t") %in% names(gaze_ok))) {
  gaze_coast_sum <- gaze_ok %>%
    filter(is.na(is_test) | !is_test, spinning == 1) %>%
    left_join(
      spins_c %>% select(session_id, round, spin_index, spin_t_land = t_land),
      by = c("session_id", "round", "spin_index")
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(spin_t_land), !is.na(t), t <= spin_t_land) %>%
    mutate(ms_to_land = spin_t_land - t) %>%
    group_by(session_id, participant_id, round, spinner_type) %>%
    summarise(
      dist_needle_late = finite_mean(dist_needle[ms_to_land <= 500]),
      dist_needle_early = finite_mean(dist_needle[ms_to_land >= 2000]),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(needle_approach = dist_needle_early - dist_needle_late)
}

gaze_features <- gaze_aoi %>%
  left_join(gaze_jump, by = c("session_id", "participant_id", "round", "spinner_type")) %>%
  left_join(gaze_coast_sum, by = c("session_id", "participant_id", "round", "spinner_type"))

gaze_rating <- gaze_features %>%
  left_join(
    rounds_c %>% select(session_id, round, flow, liking, happiness, n_spins),
    by = c("session_id", "round")
  ) %>%
  group_by(participant_id) %>%
  mutate(
    flow_w = flow - mean(flow, na.rm = TRUE),
    liking_w = liking - mean(liking, na.rm = TRUE),
    happiness_w = happiness - mean(happiness, na.rm = TRUE),
    flow_b = mean(flow, na.rm = TRUE),
    liking_b = mean(liking, na.rm = TRUE),
    happiness_b = mean(happiness, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

gaze_dvs <- c(
  "prop_needle_spin",
  "prop_wheel_spin",
  "mean_dist_needle_spin",
  "mean_ecc_spin",
  "mean_jump_px",
  "needle_approach",
  "mean_dist_shape_vis",
  "prop_near_shape",
  "prop_needle_spin_minus_idle"
)

gaze_dv_labels <- c(
  prop_needle_spin = "Prop. on needle (spinning)",
  prop_wheel_spin = "Prop. on wheel (spinning)",
  mean_dist_needle_spin = "Mean dist. to needle, px (spinning)",
  mean_ecc_spin = "Mean eccentricity (wheel radii)",
  mean_jump_px = "Sample-to-sample jump, px",
  needle_approach = "Needle approach (early − late dist.)",
  mean_dist_shape_vis = "Mean dist. to visible shape, px",
  prop_near_shape = "Prop. on visible shape",
  prop_needle_spin_minus_idle = "Needle AOI: spinning − idle"
)

cat("Wheels with gaze summaries:", nrow(gaze_rating), "\n")
gaze_rating %>%
  group_by(spinner_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    across(any_of(gaze_dvs), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Correlations

Pairwise, nested in people (untested). Gaze columns that are all missing are dropped.

```{r gaze-rating-cor, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
cor_vars <- c("flow", "liking", "happiness", "n_spins", gaze_dvs)
cor_data <- gaze_rating %>%
  select(any_of(cor_vars)) %>%
  select(where(~ sum(!is.na(.x)) >= 3))

if (ncol(cor_data) >= 2 && nrow(na.omit(cor_data)) >= 3) {
  cm <- cor(cor_data, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  print(round(cm, 2))
  as_tibble(cm, rownames = "var1") %>%
    pivot_longer(-var1, names_to = "var2", values_to = "r") %>%
    mutate(
      var1 = recode(var1, !!!gaze_dv_labels, .default = var1),
      var2 = recode(var2, !!!gaze_dv_labels, .default = var2)
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(var1, var2, fill = r)) +
    geom_tile() +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", r)), size = 2.6) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(limits = c(-1, 1), name = "r") +
    labs(
      x = NULL, y = NULL,
      title = "Round-level correlations: ratings and gaze"
    ) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1))
} else {
  cat("Not enough complete rows for a correlation matrix.\n")
}
```

```{r gaze-rating-scatter, fig.width=9, fig.height=8}
rating_long <- gaze_rating %>%
  select(participant_id, spinner_type, flow, liking, happiness, any_of(gaze_dvs)) %>%
  pivot_longer(any_of(gaze_dvs), names_to = "measure", values_to = "gaze") %>%
  mutate(measure = recode(measure, !!!gaze_dv_labels)) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(flow, liking, happiness), names_to = "rating", values_to = "score") %>%
  filter(is.finite(gaze), is.finite(score))

if (nrow(rating_long) > 0) {
  ggplot(rating_long, aes(score, gaze, color = spinner_type)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6, colour = "black") +
    facet_grid(measure ~ rating, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(
      x = "Rating",
      y = "Gaze measure",
      color = "Spinner",
      title = "Each gaze measure against flow, liking, and happiness"
    ) +
    theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0))
} else {
  cat("No paired rating–gaze rows to plot.\n")
}
```

## Hierarchical models

`gaze ~ flow_w + liking_w + happiness_w + spinner_type + round + (1 | participant)`. With two or more people, person means (`flow_b`, …) are also entered so the within-person slopes are not mixed with stable individual differences. The table keeps the rating coefficients; full `summary()` for each DV is printed underneath.

```{r gaze-rating-hlm}
tidy_fixed <- function(model) {
  if (is.null(model)) return(tibble())
  out <- try(broom.mixed::tidy(model, effects = "fixed"), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(out, "try-error") || !is.data.frame(out)) {
    out <- try(broom::tidy(model), silent = TRUE)
  }
  if (inherits(out, "try-error") || !is.data.frame(out)) return(tibble())
  out
}

n_id <- n_distinct(gaze_rating$participant_id)
use_between <- n_id >= 2

hlm_rhs <- if (use_between) {
  "flow_w + liking_w + happiness_w + flow_b + liking_b + happiness_b + spinner_type + round + (1 | participant_id)"
} else {
  "flow_w + liking_w + happiness_w + spinner_type + round + (1 | participant_id)"
}

rating_terms <- c(
  "flow_w", "liking_w", "happiness_w",
  "flow_b", "liking_b", "happiness_b"
)

gaze_hlm_list <- list()
gaze_hlm_coef <- purrr::map_dfr(gaze_dvs, function(dv) {
  dat <- gaze_rating %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(.data[[dv]]),
      is.finite(flow_w), is.finite(liking_w), is.finite(happiness_w)
    )
  if (nrow(dat) < 4 || n_distinct(dat$spinner_type) < 2) {
    cat(dv, ": skipped (too few rows).\n")
    return(tibble())
  }
  form <- stats::as.formula(paste(dv, "~", hlm_rhs))
  model <- fit_gaussian(form, dat)
  gaze_hlm_list[[dv]] <<- model
  tidy_fixed(model) %>%
    filter(term %in% rating_terms) %>%
    mutate(dv = dv, .before = 1)
})

if (nrow(gaze_hlm_coef) > 0) {
  gaze_hlm_coef <- gaze_hlm_coef %>%
    mutate(dv_label = recode(dv, !!!gaze_dv_labels))
  print(gaze_hlm_coef)

  p_coef <- ggplot(gaze_hlm_coef, aes(x = estimate, y = term)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point() +
    facet_wrap(~ dv_label, scales = "free_x") +
    labs(
      x = "Fixed-effect estimate (approx. 95% CI)",
      y = NULL,
      title = "Rating slopes for each gaze DV"
    )
  if ("std.error" %in% names(gaze_hlm_coef)) {
    p_coef <- p_coef +
      geom_errorbar(
        aes(
          xmin = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
          xmax = estimate + 1.96 * std.error
        ),
        height = 0.2,
        orientation = "y"
      )
  }
  print(p_coef)
}

purrr::iwalk(gaze_hlm_list, function(model, dv) {
  cat("\n===== ", dv, " =====\n", sep = "")
  summarize_fit(model)
})
```

Single-rating checks (same controls, one rating at a time) in case flow, liking, and happiness are too collinear to interpret jointly.

```{r gaze-rating-hlm-separate}
sep_rhs_w <- if (use_between) {
  list(
    flow = "flow_w + flow_b + spinner_type + round + (1 | participant_id)",
    liking = "liking_w + liking_b + spinner_type + round + (1 | participant_id)",
    happiness = "happiness_w + happiness_b + spinner_type + round + (1 | participant_id)"
  )
} else {
  list(
    flow = "flow_w + spinner_type + round + (1 | participant_id)",
    liking = "liking_w + spinner_type + round + (1 | participant_id)",
    happiness = "happiness_w + spinner_type + round + (1 | participant_id)"
  )
}

sep_need <- list(
  flow = "flow_w",
  liking = "liking_w",
  happiness = "happiness_w"
)

gaze_sep_coef <- purrr::map_dfr(names(sep_rhs_w), function(rating) {
  purrr::map_dfr(gaze_dvs, function(dv) {
    dat <- gaze_rating %>%
      filter(is.finite(.data[[dv]]), is.finite(.data[[sep_need[[rating]]]]))
    if (nrow(dat) < 4) return(tibble())
    form <- stats::as.formula(paste(dv, "~", sep_rhs_w[[rating]]))
    tidy_fixed(fit_gaussian(form, dat)) %>%
      filter(term %in% c(paste0(rating, "_w"), paste0(rating, "_b"))) %>%
      mutate(dv = dv, rating = rating, .before = 1)
  })
})

if (nrow(gaze_sep_coef) > 0) {
  print(gaze_sep_coef %>% select(dv, rating, term, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value))
} else {
  cat("Separate rating models skipped.\n")
}
```

# 12. Gazemaps

Wheel-centered, radius-normalized coordinates (`wx`, `wy`). Screen y increases downward; plots use `-wy` so the top of the screen is up. Restricted to spinning samples with eccentricity < 3 wheel radii. Descriptive only.

```{r gazemap-helpers}
circle_df <- tibble(
  angle = seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 200),
  x = cos(angle),
  y = sin(angle)
)

# Typical needle box in wheel units from the gaze table (session median).
needle_schematic <- gaze_spin %>%
  filter(!is_test) %>%
  summarise(
    nx = median(nx, na.rm = TRUE),
    ny = median(ny, na.rm = TRUE),
    nw = median(nw, na.rm = TRUE),
    nh = median(nh, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

needle_layer <- if (nrow(needle_schematic) == 1 && is.finite(needle_schematic$nw[[1]])) {
  geom_rect(
    data = needle_schematic,
    aes(
      xmin = nx - nw / 2,
      xmax = nx + nw / 2,
      ymin = -(ny + nh / 2),
      ymax = -(ny - nh / 2)
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = NA,
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.4
  )
} else {
  geom_blank()
}

add_wheel_overlay <- function(p) {
  p +
    geom_path(
      data = circle_df,
      aes(x, y),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = 0.4,
      colour = "white",
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    needle_layer +
    coord_fixed(xlim = c(-2.5, 2.5), ylim = c(-2.5, 2.5), expand = FALSE) +
    labs(x = "Horizontal (wheel radii)", y = "Vertical (wheel radii, up = top of screen)")
}

# Prefer spinning, non-test samples. If those filters empty the table, keep
# whatever gaze_ok still has so the maps are not blank.
gazemap_data <- gaze_spin %>% filter(is.na(is_test) | !is_test)
if (nrow(gazemap_data) == 0) gazemap_data <- gaze_spin
if (nrow(gazemap_data) == 0) {
  gazemap_data <- gaze_ok %>% filter(is.na(is_test) | !is_test)
}
if (nrow(gazemap_data) == 0) gazemap_data <- gaze_ok
gazemap_data <- gazemap_data %>% mutate(plot_y = -wy)
if (nrow(gazemap_data) == 0) {
  cat("No gazemap data: no gaze rows with x,y survived the inclusion steps above.\n")
} else {
  cat("Gazemap samples:", nrow(gazemap_data), "\n")
}

gazemap <- function(df, title) {
  if (nrow(df) < 20) {
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(wx, plot_y)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.25, size = 0.4) +
      labs(title = paste0(title, " (points; n = ", nrow(df), ")"))
  } else {
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(wx, plot_y)) +
      stat_density_2d(
        geom = "raster",
        aes(fill = after_stat(density)),
        contour = FALSE,
        n = 80
      ) +
      scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", name = "Density") +
      labs(title = title)
  }
  add_wheel_overlay(p) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "grey10", colour = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)
    )
}
```

## Spinning vs idle, and just after shape onset

```{r gazemap-splits, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
if (nrow(gaze_ok) > 0) {
  split_df <- gaze_ok %>%
    filter(!is_test, ecc < 3) %>%
    mutate(
      plot_y = -wy,
      epoch = case_when(
        spinning == 1 ~ "spinning",
        TRUE ~ "idle"
      )
    )
  print(gazemap(split_df, "Spinning vs idle") + facet_wrap(~ epoch))

  onset <- gaze_ok %>%
    filter(!is_test, shape_visible == 1, !is.na(ms_from_onset),
           ms_from_onset >= 0, ms_from_onset <= 400, ecc < 3) %>%
    mutate(plot_y = -wy)
  if (nrow(onset) > 0) {
    print(gazemap(onset, "0–400 ms after shape onset"))
  }
}
```

# 13. What these models are (and are not)

- Confirmatory inference is the **6-level spinner type** on flow, liking, and happiness, with presentation order and a participant intercept.
- Contrasts separate **reward magnitude** (`all5` vs `all1`; E = 3 wheels vs the two extremes) from **uncertainty among the four E = 3 wheels**.
- Gaze maps and needle/distractor summaries are secondary and descriptive or controlled associations. They do not license “flow causes focused attention.”
- The gaze-as-DV models ask whether same-round ratings predict looking, after wheel type and (when possible) each child’s own rating mean. That is still an association.
- Webcam tracking is approximate. Needle and shape measures are toward vs. away, not research-grade fixations.

# Appendix (exploratory — not for inference)

Do not use this section for claims in a paper.

## A. Condition means in variance space (no quadratic test)

`all1`, `low`, and `all5` share variance 0. A quadratic in variance is not identified.

```{r appendix-variance-plot, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
cond_means <- rounds_c %>%
  group_by(spinner_type) %>%
  summarise(
    reward_variance = mean(reward_variance, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_flow = mean(flow, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p_var <- ggplot(cond_means, aes(x = reward_variance, y = mean_flow, label = spinner_type)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(
    x = "Programmed reward variance",
    y = "Mean flow",
    title = "Six discrete wheels — not a variance continuum"
  )
if (requireNamespace("ggrepel", quietly = TRUE)) {
  p_var <- p_var + ggrepel::geom_text_repel()
} else {
  p_var <- p_var + geom_text(vjust = -0.6, size = 3)
}
p_var
```

## B. Round-level RPE and surprise recode spinner type

Forced sequences are shared across participants. Within a wheel, every outcome has the same programmed probability, so mean surprise and mean |RPE| at the round level are essentially properties of `spinner_type`.

```{r appendix-rpe-table}
spins_c %>%
  group_by(spinner_type) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rpe = mean(rpe_design, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_abs_rpe = mean(abs_rpe_design, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_surprise = mean(outcome_surprise, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

Optional sketch: spin-level running RPE (experienced mean of *prior* outcomes on that wheel, not a result).

```{r appendix-running-rpe}
running <- spins_c %>%
  arrange(session_id, round, spin_index) %>%
  group_by(session_id, round) %>%
  mutate(
    prior_mean = lag(cummean(outcome)),
    running_rpe = outcome - prior_mean
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

running %>%
  filter(!is.na(running_rpe)) %>%
  group_by(spinner_type) %>%
  summarise(mean_running_rpe = mean(running_rpe), n = n(), .groups = "drop")
```

## C. Median-split liking × flow cells

Cutpoints are the sample medians and will move when people are added.

```{r appendix-median-split}
med_l <- median(rounds_c$liking, na.rm = TRUE)
med_f <- median(rounds_c$flow, na.rm = TRUE)

rounds_c %>%
  filter(!is.na(liking), !is.na(flow)) %>%
  mutate(
    cell = case_when(
      liking >= med_l & flow >= med_f ~ "high liking / high flow",
      liking >= med_l & flow < med_f ~ "high liking / low flow",
      liking < med_l & flow >= med_f ~ "low liking / high flow",
      TRUE ~ "low liking / low flow"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(cell)
```

## D. Lagged persistence (T = 6; Nickell bias)

Not Poisson: spins are 4–12. A lagged Gaussian model is shown only as a sketch.

```{r appendix-lag}
lagged <- rounds_c %>%
  group_by(participant_id, session_id) %>%
  arrange(round, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    prior_flow = lag(flow),
    next_n_spins = lead(n_spins)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(prior_flow), !is.na(next_n_spins))

if (nrow(lagged) > 0) {
  lag_m <- fit_gaussian(
    next_n_spins ~ prior_flow + spinner_type + (1 | participant_id),
    lagged
  )
  summarize_fit(lag_m)
  ggplot(lagged, aes(prior_flow, next_n_spins)) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0.15, alpha = 0.5) +
    labs(
      x = "Flow in round t",
      y = "Spins in round t + 1",
      title = "Lagged persistence (exploratory; T = 6)"
    )
}
```

## E. Concurrent flow and happiness

Same-round ratings. Association, not `flow → happiness`.

```{r appendix-happiness-assoc}
ggplot(rounds_c, aes(flow, happiness)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0.1, alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(x = "Flow", y = "Happiness", title = "Concurrent ratings")
```

## F. Nested correlation heatmap

The fuller rating × gaze matrix is in section 11. This cell is the smaller set that includes programmed reward properties.

```{r appendix-cor}
cor_data <- rounds_c %>%
  left_join(
    gaze_rating %>% select(session_id, round, any_of(c("prop_needle_spin", "mean_dist_needle_spin"))),
    by = c("session_id", "round")
  ) %>%
  select(flow, liking, happiness, n_spins, expected_reward, reward_variance,
         any_of(c("prop_needle_spin", "mean_dist_needle_spin")))

if (nrow(na.omit(cor_data)) > 2) {
  cm <- cor(cor_data, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  print(round(cm, 2))
  as_tibble(cm, rownames = "var1") %>%
    pivot_longer(-var1, names_to = "var2", values_to = "r") %>%
    ggplot(aes(var1, var2, fill = r)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_gradient2(limits = c(-1, 1)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "Round-level correlations (nested, untested)") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1))
}
```

## G. Sample-to-sample AOI changes (not attention switching)

WebGazer error is often 100–200 px, so region chatter at 34 ms is tracker noise.

```{r appendix-switch}
if (nrow(gaze_spin) > 0) {
  sw <- gaze_spin %>%
    filter(!is_test) %>%
    arrange(session_id, round, t) %>%
    group_by(session_id, round) %>%
    mutate(switch = on_needle != lag(on_needle)) %>%
    summarise(switch_rate = mean(switch, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  summary(sw$switch_rate)
}
```

## H. Which gaze measure tracks flow? (exploratory)

New wheel-level summaries ranked by correlation with same-round flow, plus Wu et al. (IEEE VRW 2025) constructs: I-DT fixations and saccade velocity from WebGazer, blink rate from Face Landmarker blendshapes (EAR backup), and a webcam pupil/iris proxy (iris pixel size is a head-distance confound, not Tobii pupil diameter). Sessions without `iris` rows skip blink/pupil. Uncorrected. Script: `flow_gaze_eda.R`.

Blink rules: a blink is a closure lasting 50–500 ms, detected with hysteresis (blendshape closes at ≥ 0.5 and reopens at ≤ 0.3; EAR uses a per-session cutoff of 0.75 × the open-eye median to close and 0.85 × to reopen). Face loss or a sample gap over 200 ms ends an episode without counting it. Rates are per second of valid tracking, not per second of trial. The two methods' per-sample agreement (percent and Cohen's kappa) is printed as QC; blink rate is only interpretable where they agree. `head_dist_rel` is a relative head-distance covariate, not millimetres.

```{r appendix-flow-gaze-eda}
eda_script <- "flow_gaze_eda.R"
if (file.exists(eda_script)) {
  source(eda_script, local = TRUE)
} else {
  cat("flow_gaze_eda.R not found next to this Rmd.\n")
}
```
